correctness.rationale: Independent characteristic-three coefficient expansion gives the full transposed 4×4 Hasse–Witt coefficient matrix with determinant s on its 3×3 block and permanent invertible 2×2 minor. The quintic elimination yields resultant t²Δ and the t=0 direct factorization completes smoothness for all parameters. Local branch order three at the two points t²=−1 yields one cusp per singular fiber; Riemann–Hurwitz and normalization give genera four and three. The branch-linear-system argument establishes two-dimensional moduli variation. The standalone exact checker passed; all infinite geometric assertions have explicit proofs.

value.rationale: This is a genuinely two-moduli-dimensional geometric family over a fixed supersingular elliptic curve, not a single artificial specialization. Exact polynomial identities exhibit a reduced codimension-one jump of geometric 3-rank, a simultaneous a-number and Newton polygon classification, and two cusp boundary contacts of multiplicity three. This refines general moduli-stratification existence statements with reproducible equations and local geometric boundary data. It does not claim to classify all genus-four bielliptic curves.
